150301.anh: CALLISTA, the warrior princess from the poster, stands in the ruined courtyard of an ancient Greek temple at dusk, facing the camera head-on, eyes locked on the viewer; worn bronze battle armor over a dirty linen chiton, her hand gripping an ancient spear whose tip crackles with real blue electric arcs; smoke, drifting embers and fallen marble columns behind her, wind lifting loose strands of her hair; medium close-up, eye level
150301.dong: Slow steady push-in toward CALLISTA's face. She does not blink, raises her chin slightly and tightens her grip on the spear as blue electric arcs crawl up the shaft and light her face from below; embers drift across frame, her hair moves in the wind; no cut
150301.ket: Close-up of CALLISTA's face lit blue by the crackling spear, eyes still locked on the viewer, a faint defiant smile
